name: bips
description: The **Barangay Information Portal System** is a web-based application designed to digitize and centralize barangay services in the Philippines.

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
